{{Top|leg}}
The '''XA-8 starfighter''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] class in use by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] they were used in the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]].<ref name="The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance">[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]</ref>
